propositions: rebar search returns full ticket bodies including descriptions and all comments, causing excessive output size (~203 KB) that exhausts agent context during discovery
there is no durable stored summary field in the event/state schema, requiring derived summaries truncated from descriptions to 240 characters
rebar search does not recognize --output flag and exits with status 2 instead of supporting json and llm output formats
search results need to include bounded match snippets case-preserving and whitespace-normalized to 240 characters, extracted from the first matching term in the searchable string
predicate-only and negation-only queries must return null snippets rather than bounded text
the legacy full-state JSON shape must remain available via rebar search --full for backwards compatibility, while --full combined with --output llm must be rejected as incompatible
